# Handoff: local-9b @ 128k

## Done (verified)
- local-9b Q5 @ 128k: 37.8 t/s, VRAM 7881 MiB (measure_decode.ps1 -Ctx 131072 -NPredict 1024).

2. Review the names of the scratchpad temp files (noted repeatedly, never done).

- No code changes beyond the recipe; diffs were formatting only.
